table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Godown = (SELECT Godown.Name FROM Godown WHERE Godown.GCode = :ar_gcode),
	Code = i.icatcode, 
	Name = ic.Name,
	openqty	 				= SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	openvalue 				= SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' THEN qty * Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2) ELSE 0 END),
	QtyIN 	 				= SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('PV','SR','RV','AI','TI') THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	QtyIn_SaleValue 		= SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('PV', 'SR', 'RV', 'AI', 'TI') THEN qty * Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2) ELSE 0 END),
	QtyIn_PurValue 		= SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('PV', 'SR', 'RV', 'AI', 'TI') THEN qty * CASE :ar_price WHEN 1 THEN Round(i.purprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2) ELSE Round(Avgprice, 2) END ELSE 0 END),
	QtyOut	 				= SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('PR', 'SV', 'IV', 'AD', 'TO', 'DS') THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	QtyOut_SaleValue 		= SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('PR', 'SV', 'IV', 'AD', 'TO', 'DS') THEN qty * Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2) ELSE 0 END),
	QtyOut_PurValue 		= SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('PR', 'SV', 'IV', 'AD', 'TO', 'DS') THEN qty * CASE :ar_price 
	WHEN 1 THEN Round(i.purprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2) ELSE Round(Avgprice, 2) END ELSE 0 END),
	ClosingQty				= SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('PR', 'SV', 'IV', 'AD', 'TO', 'DS') THEN -qty ELSE qty END),
	ClosingQty_SaleValue = SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('PR', 'SV', 'IV', 'AD', 'TO', 'DS') THEN -qty ELSE qty END * Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2)),
	ClosingQty_PurValue  = SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('PR', 'SV', 'IV', 'AD', 'TO', 'DS') THEN -qty ELSE qty END * CASE :ar_price WHEN 1 THEN Round(i.purprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2) ELSE Round(Avgprice, 2) END)
FROM
	(SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = sum(qty), value=0
	FROM	(select	pd.icode, qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
			when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
			else looseqty + bonusqty end, 0))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
			pd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND

	      pl.postdate < :ar_startdate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	pd.icode,
		qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
	WHERE pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
			pd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      pl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			sd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND sd.Due IS NULL
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			sd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.postdate < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = -sum(sd.qty)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
			sd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = sum(sd.qty)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
			sd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.postdate < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
			sd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.posteddate < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty = -sum(sd.looseqty)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
			sd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode, qty = -sum(sd.qty)
	FROM THeader sl, TDetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Transcode = sd.Transcode and 
			sl.SGcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.postdate < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.qty)
	FROM THeader sl, TDetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Transcode = sd.Transcode and 
			sl.DGcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.postdate < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	d.icode,
		qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
			d.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      h.duesatisfydate < :ar_startdate
	Group By d.icode) A
	GROUP BY icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PV',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(case pl.purcatcode when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
				when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
				else (looseqty + bonusqty) end),
		value = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			else looseqty + bonusqty 
			end, 0) * pd.purprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
		pd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
		pl.postdate >= :ar_startdate and pl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PR',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits),
		value = sum((pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits) *
			pd.prprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
	WHERE pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
			pd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      pl.date >= :ar_startdate and pl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
			sd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SR',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			sd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.postdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='IV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
			sd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='DS',
		d.icode,
		qty = sum(d.duesatisfyqty),
		value = sum(d.duesatisfyqty * (d.packsaleprice / case d.packunits when 0 then 1 else d.packunits end))
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode = d.duesatisfycode AND
			d.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      h.duesatisfydate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By d.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='RV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
			sd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.postdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AI',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
			sd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.posteddate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AD',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
			sd.Gcode = :ar_gcode AND
	      sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='TO',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * (sd.saleprice / CASE sd.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE sd.packunits END))
	FROM THeader sl, TDetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Transcode = sd.Transcode and 
		sl.SGcode = :ar_gcode AND
		sl.postdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='TI',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * (sd.saleprice / CASE sd.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE sd.packunits END))
	FROM THeader sl, TDetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Transcode = sd.Transcode and 
		sl.DGcode = :ar_gcode AND
		sl.postdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = 0, value=0 FROM ITEM) St, 
	Item i, 
	itemcategory ic
WHERE st.icode = i.icode and
		i.icatcode in (:ar_icatcode) and 
		i.icatcode = ic.icatcode
GROUP BY i.icatcode, ic.Name
ORDER BY ic.name

objects.name: compute_13
objects.expression: avg((( qtyout_salevalue - qtyout_purvalue ) / qtyout_purvalue) * 100 for all)
